chunks: And through his chain of narration, from Ali (peace be upon him), he said:
The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said: "I love for you what I love for myself, and I dislike for you what I dislike for it."

key_terms.صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ: Peace be upon him and his family

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet say about his love for Ali?
ai.summary: This hadith, recorded by Shaykh al-Saduq, underscores the spiritual and emotional unity between the Prophet and Imam Ali, reflecting the concept of *Mawaddah* (affection) that is central to Shia theology. It serves as a foundational proof for the Prophet's special love for Ali, often cited in discussions of the *Hadith al-Mawaddah* and the divine selection of the Ahl al-Bayt. The statement implies that Ali’s preferences are not merely personal but aligned with the Prophet’s own, highlighting their shared spiritual authority.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 31-312 According to the same documentation on the authority of Ali (a.s.),
the Prophet (S) said, “I desire for you what I desire for myself and dislike for you what I dislike for myself.”
